name: application-resizable-column-header
title: Resizable Column Header
description: Table header row with a sort-caret toggle button per column and a drag-to-resize handle on each column's trailing edge, backed by table-fixed so widths hold.
useWhen: Building a data-dense table or spreadsheet-like grid where users need to both sort and manually widen/narrow columns.
You want the resize handle discoverable only on hover, not always visible, to keep the header visually clean.
Distinct from Column Visibility Menu, which toggles whole columns on/off from a dropdown, rather than resizing or sorting the columns already shown.
avoidWhen: You need to show/hide entire columns — use Column Visibility Menu instead.
Column widths never need to change — a plain sortable header is simpler without the resize handles.
responsiveBehavior: The table uses table-fixed with explicit per-column pixel widths so resizing one column doesn't reflow the others unexpectedly; resize handles are hover-revealed via group-hover to stay unobtrusive at any width.
accessibility: Each sort trigger is a real button with an aria-label stating the column and, when active, the current sort direction.
Sort direction is conveyed by both an arrow icon rotation and the aria-label text, never rotation alone.
The resize handle is a decorative aria-hidden element since resizing is a pointer-only enhancement with no equivalent keyboard requirement for reading the table.

variants.title: Resizable Column Header
variants.description: Three-column table (Name/Status/Updated) with Name actively sorted ascending and hover-revealed resize handles between columns.
accessibility: Sort buttons carry aria-labels stating column and current direction when active.

variants.title: Resizable Column Header (Dark)
variants.description: The same header adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Sort caret and resize-handle contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
